scripts.dev: npm run db:up && npm run db:wait && npm run migrate && npm run seed && concurrently -k -P -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run -w shared typecheck && npm run -w backend typecheck && npm run -w frontend typecheck && tsc -p e2e
scripts.test:e2e: npm run -w backend test:e2e && playwright test
scripts.verify: npm run db:up && npm run db:wait && npm run migrate && npm run migrate:test && npm run seed && npm run -w backend seed:test && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test && npm run test:e2e
